verses.ar: اِقۡتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانۡشَقَّ الۡقَمَرُ
verses.en: The Hour (of doom) has drawn near, and the moon has split asunder.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا اٰيَةً يُّعۡرِضُوۡا وَيَقُوۡلُوۡا سِحۡرٌ مُّسۡتَمِرٌّ
verses.en: When these people see a sign, they turn away and say, “(This is) a transient magic.”

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ وَكُلُّ اَمۡرٍ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّ
verses.en: They have rejected (the Truth) and followed their desires, while every matter has to settle (at some time).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَنۭۡ بَآءِ مَا فِيۡهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌۙ‏
verses.en: And there has come to them as much news (of the earlier communities) as it is enough to deter,

verses.ar: حِكۡمَةٌۭ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغۡنِ النُّذُرُۙ‏
verses.en: (containing) a perfect wisdom. But the warnings are of no avail (to them).

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰي شَيۡءٍ نُّكُرٍۙ‏
verses.en: Therefore, turn aside (O Prophet,) from them. (They will see the reality) on the day in which the caller will call (them) to a gruesome object.

verses.ar: خُشَّعًا اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٌ مُّنۡتَشِرٌۙ‏
verses.en: With their eyes humbled, they will come out of the graves like locusts spread all over,

verses.ar: مُّهۡطِعِيۡنَ اِلَي الدَّاعِؕ يَقُوۡلُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.en: rushing quickly towards the caller. (On that Day) the disbelievers will say, “This is a hard day.”

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ فَكَذَّبُوۡا عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُوۡا مَجۡنُوۡنٌ وَّازۡدُجِرَ
verses.en: The people of NūH denied (the truth) before them. So they rejected Our servant, and said, “(He is) a madman”, and he was (also) threatened (by them).

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَغۡلُوۡبٌ فَانۡتَصِرۡ‏
verses.en: So he prayed to his Lord saying, “I am overpowered, so defend (me).”

verses.ar: فَفَتَحۡنَا٘ اَبۡوَابَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنۡهَمِرٍؗۖ‏
verses.en: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring forth profusely,

verses.ar: وَّفَجَّرۡنَا الۡاَرۡضَ عُيُوۡنًا فَالۡتَقَي الۡمَآءُ عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡرٍ قَدۡ قُدِرَۚ‏
verses.en: and We caused the earth to gush forth as springs; so the water (of both kinds) met together for a destined event.

verses.ar: وَحَمَلۡنٰهُ عَلٰي ذَاتِ اَلۡوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍۙ‏
verses.en: And We caused him (NūH) to board that (ship) which had planks and nails,

verses.ar: تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَنۡ كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.en: which sailed under Our Eyes, as a reward for the one who was rejected (by the infidels).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ تَّرَكۡنٰهَا٘ اٰيَةً فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We left it (the ship) as a sign. So, is there one to take lesson?

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: Then how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: (The people of) ‘Ād rejected (their prophet). So how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِيۡ يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٍ مُّسۡتَمِرٍّۙ‏
verses.en: We did send to them a furious wind in a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.ar: تَنۡزِعُ النَّاسَۙ كَاَنَّهُمۡ اَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ مُّنۡقَعِرٍ
verses.en: plucking people away, as if they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: So how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ بِالنُّذُرِ
verses.en: (The people of) Thamūd rejected the warners.

verses.ar: فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗ٘ۙ اِنَّا٘ اِذًا لَّفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ
verses.en: So they said, “Shall we follow a single human being from among us? Then we will be in error and insanity.

verses.ar: ءَاُلۡقِيَ الذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ
verses.en: Is it that the advice has been cast upon him alone out of all of us? No, but he is a bragging liar.”

verses.ar: سَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الۡكَذَّابُ الۡاَشِرُ
verses.en: Tomorrow they will know who the bragging liar is!

verses.ar: اِنَّا مُرۡسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةً لَّهُمۡ فَارۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَاصۡطَبِرۡؗ‏
verses.en: We are going to send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch them (O SāliH,) and keep patience,

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ اَنَّ الۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةٌۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ كُلُّ شِرۡبٍ مُّحۡتَضَرٌ
verses.en: and tell them that water (of the well) is to be shared between them (and the she-camel), so as the right of having water shall be attended by each (alternatively).

verses.ar: فَنَادَوۡا صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطٰي فَعَقَرَ
verses.en: Then they called their man (to kill the she-camel,) so he undertook (the task) and killed (the she-camel).

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: So how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوۡا كَهَشِيۡمِ الۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
verses.en: We sent upon them a single Cry, and they were like crushed leafs of a hedge-builder.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍۭ بِالنُّذُرِ
verses.en: The people of LūT rejected the warners.

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا اِلَّا٘ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍؕ نَجَّيۡنٰهُمۡ بِسَحَرٍۙ‏
verses.en: We sent upon them a rain of stones, except the family of LūT whom We saved in the last hours of night,

verses.ar: نِّعۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَاؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡ مَنۡ شَكَرَ
verses.en: as a grace from Us. This is how We reward the one who offers gratitude.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَنۡذَرَهُمۡ بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡا بِالنُّذُرِ
verses.en: And he (LūT) had certainly warned them of Our grasp, but they disputed the warnings.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ رَاوَدُوۡهُ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِهٖ فَطَمَسۡنَا٘ اَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And they had even tried to tempt him against his guests (so that they may snatch them away for bad purpose,) but We blinded their eyes: “Now taste My torment and My warnings!”

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُمۡ بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّۚ‏
verses.en: And on the next morning, a lasting torment overtook them:

verses.ar: فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: “Now taste My torment and My warnings.”

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ النُّذُرُۚ‏
verses.en: And the warners came to the family of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

verses.ar: كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ اَخۡذَ عَزِيۡزٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
verses.en: (But) they rejected all Our signs; so We seized them- a seizure by One Mighty, Powerful.

verses.ar: اَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اُولٰٓئِكُمۡ اَمۡ لَكُمۡ بَرَآءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِۚ‏
verses.en: Are the disbelievers among you in a better position than all of the aforesaid (punished people), or do you have immunity (recorded) in the sacred books?

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيۡعٌ مُّنۡتَصِرٌ
verses.en: Or do they say, “We are a large group, well-defended.”?

verses.ar: سَيُهۡزَمُ الۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّوۡنَ الدُّبُرَ
verses.en: Soon this ‘large group’ shall be defeated, and all of them will turn their backs.

verses.ar: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدۡهٰي وَاَمَرُّ
verses.en: Rather the Hour (of judgment) is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour is more calamitous and much more bitter.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍۘ‏
verses.en: Surely the guilty ones are in error and madness.

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُوۡنَ فِي النَّارِ عَلٰي وُجُوۡهِهِمۡؕ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.en: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, (it will be said to them,) “Taste the touch of Hell.”

verses.ar: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.en: Verily, We have created every thing according to (Our) predestination.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَمۡرُنَا٘ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمۡحٍۭ بِالۡبَصَرِ
verses.en: And (implementation of) Our command is no more than a single act like the twinkling of an eye.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا٘ اَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: We have destroyed people like you; so, is there one to take lesson?

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٍ فَعَلُوۡهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ
verses.en: And every thing they have done is recorded in the books (of deeds).

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيۡرٍ وَّكَبِيۡرٍ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
verses.en: And every thing, small and big, is written down.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَهَرٍۙ‏
verses.en: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and rivers,

verses.ar: فِيۡ مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِنۡدَ مَلِيۡكٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍࣖ‏
verses.en: in a seat of Truth, near to the Omnipotent Sovereign.
